summary: The Export-Import Bank of Korea filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a proposed offering of USD-denominated senior notes, including green notes, with interest rates and principal amounts to be determined. The notes are to be listed on the Singapore Exchange and the Euro MTF Market of the Luxembourg Stock Exchange, with Citigroup, Crédit Agricole CIB, HSBC, J.P. Morgan, and Morgan Stanley as joint bookrunners and lead managers. This is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf registration statement, not a special situation event. There are no activist, M&A, restructuring, or capital return elements. The filing pertains solely to capital markets financing.
